Query BigQuery as the signed-in user

Source: R/backend__bigquery.R
oauth_db_bigquery_api.Rd

Run BigQuery SQL and browse datasets using each visitor's Google account. Queries run as jobs in your chosen Google Cloud project and return data frames for the Shiny app. Users need permission to run jobs in that project and read the data.

Usage

oauth_db_bigquery_api(
  authorization,
  project,
  dataset = NULL,
  location = NULL,
  target = NULL,
  required_scopes = character(),
  min_valid_for = 60,
  timeout = 300,
  page_size = 10000L,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

authorization

Function providing the visitor's current sign-in authorization. Pass auth$connection from shinyOAuth without parentheses. To select a saved account, use a function calling auth$connection(id).

project

Google Cloud project in which to run and bill queries.

dataset

Default dataset for unqualified table names, or NULL.

location

Dataset location, such as "EU" or "us-central1". NULL lets BigQuery choose it.

target

Name of the service token to use in your shinyOAuth client. Named targets let one sign-in obtain tokens for different services. NULL uses the client's default token.

required_scopes

Additional OAuth permissions to check before use. Request them on the shinyOAuth client first; this check doesn't request consent or grant database privileges.

min_valid_for

Minimum remaining token lifetime, in seconds, when obtaining a token. Use 0 to accept any unexpired token.

timeout

Maximum seconds to submit, poll, and fetch an operation.

page_size

Maximum number of rows requested per result page.

session

The visitor's Shiny session. Usually inferred when you create the helper inside server().

Value

A client object with these methods:

  • $query(sql, parameters = NULL, parameter_types = NULL, maximum_bytes_billed = NULL, use_query_cache = TRUE, raw = FALSE) runs GoogleSQL and returns a data frame.

  • $datasets() lists dataset IDs in the project.

  • $tables(dataset) lists table IDs. If omitted, dataset uses the client's default.

Details

Create the client inside server() and call its methods from render or reactive expressions. Use oauth_db_bigquery_client() for Google sign-in. No BigQuery database driver is needed.

Set project to the Google Cloud project that runs and bills queries. The data can be in another project the user can access. Set location to match the datasets you query.

Query parameters

Use named R values in parameters, such as list(country = "NL") for SQL containing @country. Character, logical, integer, numeric, Date and POSIXct values are supported; vectors become arrays.

Use a named character vector of parameter_types to choose the type or type a NULL value. Use "ARRAY<INT64>" for a one-element integer array.

Query options

Set maximum_bytes_billed to limit the bytes a query may bill. Set use_query_cache = FALSE to disable cached query results.

Result types

INT64 and decimal columns stay as strings to preserve precision. Dates become Date, timestamps become UTC POSIXct, and nested or repeated fields use list columns. BYTES fields keep their API representation.

Use raw = TRUE for the combined API response, schema and job reference. For statements that change data, inspect numDmlAffectedRows in that result; the data frame can have no columns.

Longer queries

Queries wait for completion and collect all result pages in R memory. Polling is synchronous: other Shiny sessions in the same R process can wait until the call returns. A timeout or sign-out stops fetching results but doesn't cancel a submitted BigQuery job. Each request uses a current token. HTTP 401 can trigger one refresh attempt; other errors stop the operation without resubmitting SQL.

See also

oauth_db_bigquery_client(). vignette("bigquery", package = "shinyOAuthDB") has sign-in setup and a complete app.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bigquery <- oauth_db_bigquery_api(
  auth$connection, project = "billing-project", location = "EU"
)
output$rows <- shiny::renderTable({
  bigquery$query(
    "SELECT * FROM reporting.Orders WHERE country = @country LIMIT 20",
    parameters = list(country = "NL")
  )
})
} # }
